Name: Adah, Wife of Lamech
Summary: Adah was one of Lamech's two wives and the mother of Jabal and Jubal.
KeyStory: Adah's sons became the fathers of those who live in tents and keep livestock, and of all who play the harp and flute.
RelatedPeople: Lamech, Son of Methusael; Jabal; Jubal
LifeLesson: God can bring music and honest work out of any family line.
